_comment: Hand corrections on top of overlay.generated.json. The import script never overwrites this file. See README 'Correcting the map'. Keys starting with _ are ignored.

items._example_delete: set an item id to null to remove it, e.g. "stairs-1-3": null

room-spontaneous-conversation-area._why: Green box drawn in Canva; flood-fill cannot see it. Rect copied from the PDF.

lifts-2._why: Label only present as hidden text on the 2nd-floor page; consistent with the main lift on other floors.

food-0._why: Meal times from Emily, 3 Nov 2026: Fri dinner only Cafeteria + 3rd floor

room-registration-info-desk-wardrobe._why: Label sits on the long narrow room (tan counter strip + grey room) along the hall; traced from the plan.

room-main-entrance._why: The entrance vestibule (double doors in the outer wall) right next to the label; traced from the plan.

room-humboldt-hall._why: Traced by the import since 5 Nov 2026 (divider Humboldt/Cafeteria in scripts/import-config.json); was hand-traced. Outline = the hall inside its inner walls, incl. stage.

room-kleist-hall._why: Seat rows broke the flood-fill. Inner faces of the hall's walls (incl. stage), measured on the plan.

room-arnheim-foyer._why: Traced by the import since 5 Nov 2026 (rooms up to 8 % of the page allowed); was hand-traced. Long hall from the top doors to the Nap Rooms wing; stairs, toilets, registration room and entrance vestibule are outside it.

room-edison._why: Traced by the import since 5 Nov 2026 (divider along its door wall in scripts/import-config.json); was hand-traced.

room-third-floor-foyer._why: Foyer and Voltaire are one open area on the plan, split along the row of pillars / folding partition (y 599.5): a divider in scripts/import-config.json. Traced by the import since 5 Nov 2026; was hand-traced.

room-voltaire._why: Split from the foyer by the divider at y 599.5 (scripts/import-config.json). Traced by the import since 5 Nov 2026, incl. stage; was hand-traced.

stairs-1-4._why: Same staircase as stairs-0-3 (ground floor, 'To floor 1'); its own note reads as floor 1.

stairs-2._why: 2nd-floor labels are hidden text; same spot as stairs-3 (to 1, 2) and stairs-1-2 (to 2, 3).

_decisions: 2 Nov 2026: areas painted over with grey boxes in Canva are closed off - correctly left out.
